acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a home office addition in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex varies significantly based on factors like size, complexity, and specific finish selections. Initial design and permit coordination can take several weeks to a few months, influenced by city regulations and review processes. The construction phase itself can range from a few months for a straightforward extension to longer for more intricate designs or integrations. We prioritize clear communication throughout, providing scheduling transparency so you understand each phase. Our managed process aims for efficient execution without compromising craftsmanship, ensuring timely completion within the agreed-upon timeline.
